title: 智能手表·可排心电屏幕
usage: 手表外观纸件，心电波形和报警信息另按当前镜头准确叠入；不自行诊断房颤。
prompt: ONE isolated modern wrist-worn SMARTWATCH, front-on, with a dark muted teal rounded rectangular case and an unbranded warm tan fabric strap extending a short distance above and below, complete visible ends. The screen is blank warm ivory for later accurate ECG trace; no digits, icons, letters, logo or pre-drawn waveform. Exquisite handmade fibrous cut-paper collage with gouache and colored-pencil shading, tactile layered edges, refined warm cream/teal/ochre palette, high-quality raster, not a flat vector icon. Single centered object with genuine RGBA transparent exterior, no wrist, hand, person, table, floor, scene or background halo.
